recompute_time_model.note: c2 = 2·H·d_head·L / G_node; c1 = (2·N_matmul + 2·H·d_head·L) / G_node. Recompute time per token grows with T, so a link that beats recompute at T = 1 beats it at every T.

max_break_even_bandwidth_per_gpu.note: Any tier faster than this per GPU is cheaper than recompute for every prefix length (bandwidth only).

bandwidth_only.note: Transfer per token is far below recompute per token: no crossover; reusing cached KV always wins on time.

with_overhead.formula: positive root of c2·T² + (c1 − kv_gpu/B)·T − overhead = 0
with_overhead.note: With the 2 ms HYPOTHETICAL fixed cost per transfer, recomputing is faster only for prefixes shorter than this. Above it, fetch the cached KV.

bandwidth_only.note: Transfer per token is far below recompute per token: no crossover; reusing cached KV always wins on time.

mooncake_eq2.formula_as_written: reuse beats recompute iff B / G > 2·d·s / (gqa × (a·p·d + b·d²))
mooncake_eq2.derivation: transfer time p·l·(2d/gqa)·s / B < recompute time l·(a·p²·d + b·p·d²) / G, divided by p·l and rearranged.

a.note: Causal attention: query t sees t keys, 2·d·n² per layer. The paper's a = 4 counts the full n² square (non-causal).

m_dense_mapping.B_and_G: B = node KV load bandwidth = 8 × per-GPU link; G = node compute = 8 × peak × prefill_mfu. The ratio B/G equals the per-GPU ratio.

gpu_hit_G1.label: GPU hit (G1)
gpu_hit_G1.note: Blocks are already in HBM; the engine skips prefill for the cached prefix.

cpu_hit_G2.label: CPU DRAM hit (G2) over PCIe Gen5 x16

recompute.label: miss: recompute the prefix
recompute.note: Moves no bytes between tiers; uses the whole node's compute for this time.

partial_block_tokens_recomputed.note: Tokens of a last, partly filled prefix block have no block hash, so a hit recomputes them with the suffix.

flops_attention.formula: 2 × H × d_head × L × n × (2 × c + n + 1), n = tokens prefilled, c = cached
flops_attention.note: The suffix's queries attend over the cached prefix and over earlier suffix tokens (causal).

check_attention_identity.formula: miss attention − prefix-only attention = hit attention

prefix_hit_ttft.scope: Prefill compute only. Queue time, tokenization, network and the first sampling step are the same for hit and miss and are not included.

ttft_hit_plus_load.note: Upper bound: assumes the load finishes before the suffix prefill starts (no overlap).
